scene.note: You write the lines of first-line.js, Node runs them from top to bottom, and the terminal shows what they print.

steps.note: Ines wants the shop's welcome printed, exactly as the task spells it.
Under Task 1 you add one line that prints it, with the text in quotes.
Node reads the file from the top and runs each line in turn.
The welcome shows up on a line of its own in the terminal.
The parcel note has two lines, and Ines wants them in the order the task gives.
Each line of the note gets its own print, one under the other.
Node runs the two prints in the order they are written.
The terminal shows the two lines, one right after the other.
A line under Task 3 still prints a free candle offer the shop stopped running.
Node skips every line that is a comment.
The offer no longer prints, and the line stays in the file in case Theo wants it back.
A comment is a note for the next person who opens the file, like Theo.
Node skips comments, so your note changes nothing that runs.
The terminal prints the same lines as before your note.
